# expected-lite

This directory vendors `nonstd-lite/expected-lite` v0.8.0 at commit
`182165b584dad130afaf4bcd25b8629799baea38` for GTI's C++20 backend.

Upstream: https://github.com/nonstd-lite/expected-lite

The source is distributed under the Boost Software License 1.0 in
`LICENSE.txt`. GTI's C++23 backend uses `std::expected` instead.
